# Is each location on your arcade, pool table or claw machine route worth the drive?

> Free calculator for coin-op route operators. Enter each location's weekly take, commission, visits and miles; it shows profit per route hour, the weekly take you need, and the highest commission you can pay and still earn your target. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
